name: cortico-world-feast
description: 鱼的每一天 · 先给她一天，再给她一桌饭：她自己的日程（每晚自己写明天，可以按日型给她备一张「能做的事」清单，到点过自己的时间、做完记一笔）+ 824 道菜的桌子，能端一道、端一桌，也能和她一起吃一顿。可以跟「生图工作室」「娱乐时间」「鱼的小世界」各接一小截，不装也完整可用。
author: 青

zh.description:
先给她一天，再给她一桌饭。每天晚上到点请她自己写明天怎么过（零 API Key，用已配的模型），第二天按它过；你还能按日型给她备一张「能做的事」清单，日程里就会写成真能做的一件事，而不是「在家玩」这种空白。上不上班可以一句话翻，几点吃也能由她自己按那天定；到点还有「她自己的时间」，让她挑件事做并记一笔——上班/通勤时段默认不叫，开了开关才照叫，但会换成报备的说法。主人能在「今天」面板看今天和明天的时间线、此刻她在做什么、她做过什么、往前翻往期，也能临时改掉某一段。桌上是 824 道菜（28 个菜系组），每道都有九维口味、香气、口感、余韵和一段实吃描写；她能自己按菜系挑，主人也能从面板端一道或整桌端过去（8 套内置套餐，也能自己勾几道攒成一桌存下来）；还能和她一起吃一顿：邀请她、互相喂一口，你吃了什么她也知道。同一道菜每次吃到的都不一样，吃过什么、对什么反应、口味画像跨天攒着。饭点提醒、「她的一天」和自由时间都能在配置里单独关掉。

能和这几个扩展联动，都是一个开关的事，不装就整段不出现、绝不报错：装了「生图工作室」，她写日程时会列出衣柜和场景，发图时穿着地点对得上；装了「娱乐时间」，「自己的时间」里会多一行，她能真出门逛；装了「鱼的小世界」，「自己的时间」里会多一行，她会想起周围那些地方。

en.description:
First a day of her own, then a table of food. Every evening she is asked to write tomorrow herself (no API key — it uses the model you already have), and the next day she lives it; you can also prepare a list of "things she can actually do" per day type, so the day she writes is made of real things instead of a blank "hanging out at home". On her own-time slots she picks something to do and logs it — while she is at work or commuting it stays quiet by default, and with one switch on it still speaks but as a check-in rather than "this time is yours". The Today panel shows today's and tomorrow's timeline, what she is doing right now, what she has been up to, past days, and lets you change a stretch of it. The table holds 824 dishes across 28 cuisines, each with a nine-axis flavour profile, aroma, texture, aftertaste and a full paragraph of how it actually eats. She can pick by cuisine, or you can put a dish down in front of her from the panel — or serve a whole table at once (8 built-in set meals, plus your own saved tables). You can also share a meal with her: invite her, feed each other a bite, and tell her what you are eating. The same dish never lands the same way twice, and what she ate, how it landed and her taste profile accumulate across days. Whether she works today can be flipped with one word, and she can set that day's meal times herself. Meal reminders, her day, and her own time can each be switched off in config.

It can also hook up to three other extensions, one switch each, and nothing breaks when they are absent: with the image studio installed she lists the wardrobe and scenes when writing her day, so the outfit and place match when she sends a picture; with Fun Time installed her own time gains one line and she can really go out; with Little World installed her own time gains another line and she remembers the places around her.
